key_idea: Each pair of opposite faces has the same sum, and all six numbers must be different and at most 9.
steps: We see 1, 3 and 8. The faces opposite them are hidden.
Try 2 opposite 8: 8 + 2 = 10. Then 1 needs 9 and 3 needs 7, because 1 + 9 = 10 and 3 + 7 = 10.
The numbers 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9 are all different and all from 1 to 9. It works!
